svg.title: Eventiva layer 0, group 4
svg.desc: Prerequisite arrows point toward dependent issues. Layers are derived, not approved dates. Labels and border patterns distinguish completed, current, upcoming, closed and blocked work. Every node links to its live issue; Markdown provides full titles, prerequisites and unlocks.
svg.text: Derived layers; not deadlines or acceptance.
Blocked overrides fill/border; current keeps double.
